title: One of a Ship's disk snapshots (ship-fleet snapshot ls NAME --json entries, version 1)
description: Each entry of `ship-fleet snapshot ls NAME --json`, a list of the Ship's snapshots as its driver reports them, in the order the text form lists them; `[]` when it has none. What the text form shows, nothing more: the name, when it was taken, and its note. See contracts/ship-fleet.md.

name.description: The snapshot's name, the one `snapshot rollback` and `snapshot rm` take. A snapshot made outside FleetLedger is listed as the hypervisor names it; those commands refuse a name that is not a letter followed by 1 to 39 letters, digits, - or _ (or is current).

taken.description: When it was taken; null when the hypervisor does not say.

note.description: The description stored with it (`snapshot take --note`); empty when none.

timestamp.description: UTC, RFC 3339, with a Z suffix.
